input.explanation: Check current public meaning of "Grok bot" in case the captain means the xAI product, not a Firstmate term.

content.text:
Captain, **Grok Bot** is xAI’s always-on teammate product, not the Grok chat app or the Grok CLI.

You message a named Bot like a coworker. It runs on a persistent cloud computer (browser, files, terminal), signs into your apps and sites, and keeps going after you close the laptop. Several Bots can work in parallel on that same computer, hand work to each other, and come back when they need your approval. You can also walk one through a workflow once and have it save that as a routine.

It is in beta. Access is included with paid Cursor plans (and Cursor Teams) or by linking SuperGrok / SuperGrok Plus / SuperGrok Heavy. Bot usage is billed separately from ordinary Grok and Cursor usage, and it resets weekly.

That is a different product from last turn’s Grok quota check, which was the Grok CLI login (`~/.grok/auth.json`). Grok Bot uses Cursor (or SuperGrok) account access instead. Docs: https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/overview
